description: This Java source file defines an abstract class BaseOpenmrsService that provides default implementations for the OpenmrsService interface, serving as a base class for other service implementations within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: BaseOpenmrsService
classes.description: An abstract class providing default (empty) implementations for the lifecycle methods of OpenmrsService, intended to be extended by concrete service classes.

methods.name: onShutdown
methods.description: Default implementation of the onShutdown method from OpenmrsService; does nothing by default.

methods.name: onStartup
methods.description: Default implementation of the onStartup method from OpenmrsService; does nothing by default.
